name: Manabe Kei
source:
Takurou and Nanagi's childhood friend, and Takurou's classmate. A second year at Midori Minami Academy. A cheerful girl raised in an ordinary home in Takurou's neighborhood. She sometimes calls Takurou "Sawatari-san".

Because of that, she's sometimes misunderstood as being together with Takurou, but she and Takurou don't mind. She really liked getting into Takurou's small plays. She has a good figure and looks and is easy to talk to, so she has a lot of secret admirers.

"'Kiyaa! Takurou you pervert!" I can't believe you! Idiooot!'' ...Well, you want to direct a moe childhood friend?"
